summary: PRIME uses differentiable smooth contact and FDDP to jointly refine kinematics, contact forces and inertial parameters from robot logs, with offline G1 and Go2 validation.
title: PRIME: Physically-consistent Robotic Inertial and Motion Estimation for Legged and Humanoid Robots
